definition: For all x,y at the selected world, through w x y implies y exists there. This retains only the source-side part of Tapp’s EP1 endpoint-factivity condition, not its stronger target-side part. No necessary, concrete or causally productive source is inferred.
note: Typed analyst reduction of the primary Tapp reconstruction (§6,89–91), informed by the independently materialized Latin Monologion III. Not a defense of premise truth or a new identity of through with efficient cause. Exact source/semantic comparison, examples, exclusions and remaining actual/modal applications: docs/notes/necessary-simple-plurality.md, direct ultimate-source reduction section.
